reasons: Hide canopy and front flaps use 5-6 distinct warm tan-to-umber shading steps with top-left lighting that match the Beodeul dungeon palette and tonal depth.

Surface texture density is appropriate for stretched hide at 48x48, combining subtle mottled grain on the top plane, stitched patch details, diagonal fold creases, and wooden support poles without flat fills.
Outlines are dark-umber and warm-brown tinted rather than black ink, and the tent integrates naturally with the Beodeul cave floor, stone walls, palisades, and Actor1 scale in the scene test.
